evals.prompt: UnsatisfiedLinkError the moment the app starts
evals.why: The three-way native-library name agreement — Cargo's lib name, the loadLibrary call, and the manifest's lib name — failing at runtime with a perfectly clean build. Top of the build troubleshooting table.

evals.prompt: the apk installs on my phone but my friend gets App not installed
evals.why: Distribution: signing, ABI split, or minSdk. The output filename and the certificate fingerprint are the answer to 'can anyone else install this'.

evals.prompt: I want to start a fresh project for a different game, what do I copy
evals.why: Scaffolding. Deliberately owned here rather than by the router, because the difficulty is entirely the rename blast radius and the runtime-only failures it produces — build-system knowledge.

evals.prompt: my release build is talking to a development address and I have no idea how
evals.why: Build-time configuration resolved at compile time to a silent fallback because the variable was not exported for the compiler. The defence is scanning the produced shared object, not re-reading the build script.

evals.prompt: gradle fails with a duplicate class error mentioning kotlin-stdlib
evals.why: Dependency graph conflict in the Android build. Straight build-pipeline work.

evals.prompt: what's actually safe to push to github here, I don't want to leak anything
evals.why: The publish audit. Working tree AND every ref, because deleting a file does not delete it from history, and the categories accumulate without anyone deciding to add them.

evals.prompt: my debug apk came out at like 250 megabytes
evals.why: Unstripped native symbols in a debug build. A build-stage question with a build-stage fix.
Signing configuration resolution order — environment first, then gradle properties — with the keystore kept outside the repository.

evals.prompt: boots to a black screen with nothing logged
evals.why: emulator-core. Runtime failure inside the vendored core; the build succeeded.

evals.prompt: I need the offset of the field that stores gold
my HUD buttons overlap the status bar area
how do I decode the reply frames the server used to send
the game archive is rejected before anything runs
cargo test blows up instantly for the app crate and I can't run any of my logic tests
evals.why: Testing gates. The app crate cannot be host-tested because of its platform link graph; the answer is the dependency-free selftest harness that includes the real source, plus the headless probe as a device-free gate. Owned here because it is a build/CI concern, and cross-referenced from the shared selftest convention.
